question: Which ReversalMemory eta keeps a taught Stage 1 training board correct after 10 other training boards are taught?
override: Only learner.memory.eta changes (in memory, per probe); every other learner, encoder, graph, mapping, feedback and Stockfish-review setting is the base registration's.
data: Training panels of the base registration only. Validation and final rows are never loaded.
aBoardRule: One A board per stratum (open-defender, blocked-defender, absent-defender, pinned-apparent-defender): the first training panel by panelId whose unaided scratch choice is not the certified success (if every panel of a stratum is correct at scratch, the first by panelId, flagged).
lesson: Assess the board; take its highest-scored failure and highest-scored success (ties by move name), as the rehearsal planner does; deliver each as one informative CoupledStockfishSession event (fresh all-legal assessment, preparation, verified task pulse, Stockfish value pulse) in the order failure then success.
sequence: From scratch memory: lesson on A, then one lesson on each of 10 interfering training boards, assessing A after every lesson.
interferenceRule: The 23 other training panels ordered by sha256(seed:A:panelId); the first 10. The same 10 boards and order are used for every eta.

decision.rule: Choose the largest eta whose A board is the unique top choice after all 10 interfering lessons in at least 3 of 4 probes. If none passes, no eta is chosen; a new rule class then needs registered primary-literature support, otherwise stop.

measures: A certified-move rank and correctness after every lesson
A correctness right after its own lesson
each interfering board's rank before and after its lesson
pulse channels, currents and ReversalMemory factors
scope: Diagnostic dose probe on training boards with one replica; not a gate result, not a learning claim and not biological validation.
